exchangeRate.description: Not EN as a single term: exchange rate the source used to state VAT in the tax currency.

lineRoles.description: Line id -> role. Only with `convert(..., { relations: true })`. Never changes `lines` or `totals`.

exchangeRate.description: Not EN as a single term: exchange rate the source used to state VAT in the tax currency.

lineRoles.description: Line id -> role. Only with `convert(..., { relations: true })`. Never changes `lines` or `totals`.

sourceRole.description: Role code as written in the source, e.g. 'PL:Rola:5', 'IT:SoggettoEmittente:TZ'.

AdditionalParty.description: Parties in roles EN 16931 does not model: KSeF Podmiot3 (factor, internal recipient, additional buyer, issuer on behalf of the seller, payer, VAT-group member...), FatturaPA TerzoIntermediarioOSoggettoEmittente, Facturae third party, e-arve FactorParty, eSLOG NAD roles. Payee and tax representative stay in their EN fields.

Amount.description: Monetary amount. EN 16931 allows at most 2 decimals at document level; lines may carry more in some national formats.

documentId.description: Authority-issued ID: SdI IdentificativoSdI, KSeF number, ANAF index, MARK...

secondaryId.description: Second ID if the authority issues two (ANAF upload index vs download ID, myDATA UID vs MARK).

qrPayload.description: QR code payload or URL printed on the visual (PT, GR, PL, ES).

certificateNumber.description: Number of the authority's certificate that stamped the document (CFDI NoCertificadoSAT).

stamp.description: The authority's stamp over the document, as written (CFDI SelloSAT). Not verified.

intermediary.description: Authorised intermediary that submitted the document to the authority (CFDI PAC, RfcProvCertif).

Correction.description: Why and how a corrective document corrects (KSeF KOR, Facturae rectificativa, ISDOC 2/3...).

CountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. EU member states listed; Greece is 'GR' (EL is the VAT prefix only).

CreditNoteTypeCode.description: UNCL 1001 document type codes used for credit notes (BT-3).

Decimal.description: Plain decimal string: optional sign, digits, optional fraction. No exponent, no grouping.

DeExtension.description: Germany: XRechnung / ZUGFeRD. Leitweg-ID itself is BT-10 (`buyerReference`).

name.description: Entry name, attachment name or other locator.

EnvelopeStep.description: One unwrapping step between the received file and the parsed XML.

administrativeCentres.description: DIR3 administrative centres (public sector routing): role 01 oficina contable, 02 órgano gestor, 03 unidad tramitadora.

FormatId.description: Identifier of a detected e-invoice format.

schemeId.description: ICD / EAS code, or a national label such as 'PL:NIP'.

InvoiceTypeCode.description: UNCL 1001 document type codes used for invoices (BT-3).

IsoTime.description: hh:mm:ss, optionally with a UTC offset.

ItExtension.description: Italy, FatturaPA. Fields that have no EN or generic equivalent.

unitText.description: Unit as written in the source when it was free text ('st', 'kpl', 'szt.', 'ks').

subjectToWithholding.description: Not EN: line is subject to withholding (FatturaPA Ritenuta = SI).

otherTaxes.description: Non-VAT taxes stated per line (Facturae lines can carry IVA + recargo de equivalencia).

withholdings.description: Withholdings stated per line (Facturae TaxesWithheld on InvoiceLine).

correctionState.description: How a corrective document expresses this line. KSeF corrections either list differences, or list each line twice: the state before (StanPrzed = 1) and after. Undefined for ordinary invoices.

subLines.description: Sub-lines (XRechnung extension, Factur-X EXTENDED, France EXTENDED-CTC-FR, ISDOC). Totals come from the parent.

national.description: Line-level national data (PL GTU codes and procedure, IT AltriDatiGestionali...).

from.description: Line id (BT-126) of the line that heads, adjusts or refers to the others.

rate.description: Percentage stated in the line text, for `markup` and `discount`.

method.description: How it was found. Only `model` is a guess by a language model; `rule` and `arithmetic` are deterministic.

confidence.description: `proven`: the arithmetic matches exactly and uniquely. `likely`: stated in the text or structure of the invoice. `review`: only a hint (shared ids, model output); do not act on it without a human. Absent for structural rules that cannot be wrong, such as a heading over the lines that follow it.

LineRole.description: What a line is for. `item` is anything sold; `heading` and `description` carry text only (zero quantity, price and amount); the rest adjust or add to other lines.

placeOfIssue.description: Postal code of the place of issue (LugarExpedicion). The issuer's own address is not in a CFDI.

paymentMethod.description: MetodoPago: 'PUE' paid in one payment, 'PPD' in instalments or deferred.

globalInformation.description: InformacionGlobal: invoice summarising sales to the general public.

subTotal.description: Sum of the line discounts and the pre-discount subtotal as the CFDI states them (SubTotal, Descuento).

MxExtension.description: Mexico, CFDI 3.3 / 4.0. Fields with no EN or generic equivalent; codes are SAT catalogue keys.

NationalTypeCode.description: A document type in the source format's own code list, kept next to the mapped UNCL 1001 code.

includedInTotal.description: True if the amount is already included in `totals.taxInclusive`.

inTaxExclusive.description: True if the amount is also already inside `totals.taxExclusive`, because the source charges it as a line or a charge (IT stamp duty as an N1 line). When false or absent, an `includedInTotal` amount sits on top of BT-109 + BT-110 (ES recargo de equivalencia).

OtherTax.description: Taxes that are not VAT and not withholding, and that EN 16931 cannot express: ES recargo de equivalencia, IT stamp duty (bollo), excise or environmental fees stated as taxes, IGIC/IPSI when a source keeps them apart from VAT.

nationalTaxIds.description: National tax ID that is not the VAT number and not the company register ID: IT codice fiscale, PL NIP (when no VAT prefix), ES NIF, HR OIB, GR AFM, CZ IČO. Several national formats identify parties only by this.

paymentIndex.description: Index into `payments` when the installment names its own means/account.

PaymentInstallment.description: One due date in a payment schedule. EN 16931 has a single due date (BT-9); FatturaPA (DettaglioPagamento), Facturae (Installment) and KSeF (TerminPlatnosci) can list several, with or without amounts and with or without their own account.

nationalMeansCode.description: Means code in the source code list (FatturaPA 'MP05', Facturae '04', KSeF '6'...).

clearanceId.description: Clearance ID of the referenced invoice (KSeF number, SdI ID, CFDI UUID...).

relationType.description: How this document relates to the referenced one, in the source code list (CFDI TipoRelacion '01' = credit note of the related document, '04' = substitution...).

SchemeId.description: Identifier schemes: ISO/IEC 6523 ICD codes (party, item and location IDs) and Peppol EAS codes (electronic addresses, BT-34/BT-49). Only codes whose meaning is certain are listed. Check the current EAS list before relying on a code: Peppol BIS 3.0.21 removed 14 EAS codes.

nationalTaxIds.description: National tax ID that is not the VAT number and not the company register ID: IT codice fiscale, PL NIP (when no VAT prefix), ES NIF, HR OIB, GR AFM, CZ IČO. Several national formats identify parties only by this.

verified.description: Cryptographic validity only: the signature value matches the signed content and the signer certificate's key. true = valid, false = invalid (see `reason`), undefined = could not be checked. This says nothing about who the signer is; see `trust`.

signer.description: Common name of the signer certificate.

certificate.description: Signer certificate details, as carried in the signature.

signedAt.description: Signing time (ISO 8601) from signed attributes / XAdES SigningTime, when the signature protects it.

reason.description: Why `verified` is false, or why it could not be determined.

trust.description: 'not-checked' unless trust anchors were configured: a valid signature is not a trusted signer.

qualified.description: The signer chains to a CA/QC service whose status was granted at the signing time.

evaluatedAt.description: The instant the service status was evaluated at: the signing time, or now when the signature carries none.

snapshot.description: `stale`: the snapshot is past its earliest next-update date, so the lists may have changed since.

euTrust.description: Present when an EU trusted-list snapshot was passed (`euTrust` option): the qualified-service check of the signer.

envelope.description: Path from the received file to this XML, e.g. [{kind:'zip'}, {kind:'cms-p7m'}].

fileSha256.description: SHA-256 of the file as received, and of the XML payload this invoice came from.

indexInFile.description: Position and path inside a multi-invoice file (FatturaPA lot, Facturae batch, e-arve).

provenance.description: Optional field-level provenance: canonical path -> source XPath (e.g. '/totals/payable' -> '/Invoice/cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableAmount').

splitPaymentVat.description: Not EN: VAT the buyer pays to the tax authority instead of the seller (IT split payment, EsigibilitaIVA = S). The VAT stays in `vatTotal`.

payable.description: BT-115: amount the buyer has to pay. payable = taxInclusive - prepaid + rounding - withholdingTotal - splitPaymentVat (the last two are 0 for every EN-based source).

bundles.description: Validator bundle used per layer, e.g. { profile: 'peppol-billing-3.0.21' }.

ValidationSummary.description: Validation results, kept per layer so a failure in one never reads as a pass in another (a valid signature says nothing about the schema, and the reverse). 'unavailable' means the validator could not run, which is not the same as the document failing.

taxAmountInTaxCurrency.description: Not EN: per-rate VAT in the tax currency (KSeF P_14_xW, Facturae TaxAmount/EquivalentInEuros).

nationalCode.description: Source code that drove the category: 'IT:N6.2', 'PL:P_12:oo', 'ES:E2'...

Withholding.description: Withholding taxes deducted by the buyer: IT ritenuta d'acconto / previdenziale, ES retención IRPF, PT retenção na fonte. EN 16931 has no term for these.
